supplemental_items.interpretation: Construct one NativePrimaryOrders resolver from chronology, both groups, callback and requested direction. Select detect_bullish only for exact bullish, otherwise detect_bearish; if live_stages is non-null call its primary service with direction, groups, resolver and requested E detector instead of the batch detector. Batch consumes requested S/E/StopAll groups and same resolver. After obtaining primary result select low resolution and low-label reconciliation for bullish, otherwise high counterparts; invoke resolution through market.end_index before reconciliation. Capture required identities from every existing visibility.prepared_order_audit reaction's first_idx and break_idx using order_identity; set deduplicates. Rebuild only the visibility audit using visible start/end, requested detectors, retained accepted A set and required identities. Return primary; failures propagate; callback and reconciliation effects are not locally undone.
